title: 真实LDS拒绝更新：读取具体error_state，分清失败版本与仍服务的旧active
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现summarize_listener(config_dump,name)，从唯一ListenersConfigDump中精确找到唯一同名dynamic_listener，输出status、active_version、rejected_version、error_details。error_state.details非空表示更新拒绝，active_state仍有内容时status=rejected_update_with_last_good_active，否则rejected_without_active；无拒绝详情时按active_state输出active/not_active，rejected_version=None；有拒绝详情但error_state未提供version_info也返回None，不从active或外部文件推断。版本字符串分别取相应state，不排序、不把active版本当失败版本；缺失/重名/错误状态结构ValueError。原生夹具先发布v1正常服务，再发布v2重复*虚拟主机而被拒绝，此文件订阅实际未填失败版本号；必须读取具体原因并验证旧v1业务仍正常。修复发布v3后，分别核对active listener内容和实际version-3响应，active_version仍原样提取，不能强改成发布版本：本固定版本原地更新实际可能保留旧version_info。另用注明的字段输入检查不透明失败版本号原样提取。不能以版本数字大小或静态listener可用代替动态资源和业务证据。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13 filesystem LDS订阅、admin config_dump error_state及动态listener数据面。未建立远程gRPC xDS，文件订阅不传回response_nonce/NACK请求；本题只验证资源拒绝详情、最后可用状态及实际响应，不冒充完整控制面NACK关联。

import sys,pathlib,tempfile,json,copy,os,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,free_port,request,student
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def atom(path,value):
 stage=path.with_name('.'+path.name+'.next');stage.write_text(json.dumps(value),encoding='utf8');os.replace(stage,path)
def wait(predicate,message):
 deadline=time.monotonic()+3
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  result=predicate()
  if result:return result
  time.sleep(.02)
 raise AssertionError(message+' state='+repr(state())+' log='+(proxy.root/'envoy.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-1800:])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-lds-') as directory,Upstream() as upstream:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);lds=root/'lds.json';base=bootstrap(upstream.port)
 listener=copy.deepcopy(base['static_resources']['listeners'][0]);listener['name']='dynamic-service';listener['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=free_port()
 manager=listener['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config'];manager['stat_prefix']='dynamic'
 manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[{'match':{'prefix':'/'},'direct_response':{'status':200,'body':{'inline_string':'version-1'}}}]
 listener['@type']='type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.listener.v3.Listener'
 def publish(version,resource):atom(lds,{'version_info':version,'type_url':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.listener.v3.Listener','resources':[resource]})
 publish('1',listener);base['dynamic_resources']={'lds_config':{'path':str(lds),'resource_api_version':'V3'}}
 dynamic='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(listener['address']['socket_address']['port_value'])
 with Envoy(base) as proxy:
  def dump():return json.loads(request(proxy.admin,'/config_dump')[1])
  def state():
   configs=[c for c in dump()['configs'] if c.get('@type','').endswith('.ListenersConfigDump')]
   rows=[r for c in configs for r in c.get('dynamic_listeners',[]) if r.get('name')=='dynamic-service']
   return rows[0] if rows else {}
  wait(lambda:state().get('active_state',{}).get('version_info')=='1','initial dynamic listener not active')
  assert request(dynamic,'/')[0:2]==(200,b'version-1')
  first=student(task.summarize_listener,dump(),'dynamic-service')
  assert first=={'status':'active','active_version':'1','rejected_version':None,'error_details':''},first
  rejected=copy.deepcopy(listener);vhosts=rejected['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']['route_config']['virtual_hosts']
  duplicate=copy.deepcopy(vhosts[0]);duplicate['name']='conflicting-wildcard';vhosts.append(duplicate)
  publish('2',rejected)
  wait(lambda:bool(state().get('error_state',{}).get('details')),'rejected LDS error details not observed')
  raw=dump();report=student(task.summarize_listener,raw,'dynamic-service')
  assert report['status']=='rejected_update_with_last_good_active' and report['active_version']=='1' and report['rejected_version'] is None and report['error_details'],report
  assert any(word in report['error_details'].lower() for word in ('wildcard','duplicate')),report
  assert request(dynamic,'/')[0:2]==(200,b'version-1'),'rejected version replaced last good business response'
  supplied=copy.deepcopy(raw)
  for config in supplied['configs']:
   if config.get('@type','').endswith('.ListenersConfigDump'):
    for entry in config.get('dynamic_listeners',[]):
     if entry.get('name')=='dynamic-service':entry['error_state']['version_info']='opaque-rejected-version'
  annotated=task.summarize_listener(supplied,'dynamic-service')
  assert annotated['active_version']=='1' and annotated['rejected_version']=='opaque-rejected-version' and annotated['error_details']==report['error_details']
  print('NATIVE_LDS_REJECTION_DETAILS_AND_LAST_GOOD_BUSINESS_REPRODUCED',flush=True)
  recovered=copy.deepcopy(listener);recovered['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['direct_response']['body']['inline_string']='version-3'
  publish('3',recovered)
  wait(lambda:state().get('active_state',{}).get('listener',{}).get('filter_chains',[{}])[0].get('filters',[{}])[0].get('typed_config',{}).get('route_config',{}).get('virtual_hosts',[{}])[0].get('routes',[{}])[0].get('direct_response',{}).get('body',{}).get('inline_string')=='version-3','corrected listener content not active')
  wait(lambda:request(dynamic,'/')[0:2]==(200,b'version-3'),'new active version did not serve new business response')
  final_dump=dump();final=student(task.summarize_listener,final_dump,'dynamic-service')
  actual_version=next(row['active_state']['version_info'] for config in final_dump['configs'] if config.get('@type','').endswith('.ListenersConfigDump') for row in config.get('dynamic_listeners',[]) if row['name']=='dynamic-service')
  assert final=={'status':'active','active_version':actual_version,'rejected_version':None,'error_details':''},final
  for value in [{},None]:
   try:task.summarize_listener(value,'dynamic-service')
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('missing listener dump accepted')
  repeated=copy.deepcopy(raw)
  for config in repeated['configs']:
   if config.get('@type','').endswith('.ListenersConfigDump'):
    config['dynamic_listeners'].append(copy.deepcopy(next(r for r in config['dynamic_listeners'] if r['name']=='dynamic-service')))
  try:task.summarize_listener(repeated,'dynamic-service')
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('ambiguous listener state accepted')
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
